Treat BOTH signed Dirac tails directly at the unsigned Hill index. An unproved reflection identity is not assumed. The norm gap identity and endpoint-sum lower bound give one full Sobolev order with constant2/pi and a cutoff chosen before every Sobolev order and exponent.

For each member separately, finite-p membership gives a base endpoint representative. The previously verified adapted-Fourier endpoint bootstrap then yields the target endpoint representative. This proves source2.2(i)-(ii) without assuming a uniform bound.
